methods.plantllps_logistic: PlantLLPS SGD logistic on FEATURE_NAMES; leakage-safe retrain
methods.prox_pu_style: stdlib logistic on ProX/PU-like features ['log_length', 'idr_frac', 'lcr_score', 'hydropathy_kd', 'fcr', 'ncpr', 'kappa_charge_approx', 'aromatic_frac', 'plaac_qn_frac', 'plaac_max_window_qn', 'plaac_nllr_approx', 'plaac_core_len_norm']; not published LightGBM/PU

gold_leave_out.protocol: Retrain PlantLLPS + ProX-style on v13 excluding all 28 gold IDs; score reconstructed 13+15 gold. PSAP/LLPhyScore/PLAAC are OOB.

species_transfer.reason: need ≥4 test rows with both classes
need ≥4 test rows with both classes

honesty: Fair claims use leave-gold-out / family hold-out / species-transfer AUCs only. Production-model gold AUCs remain partially in-sample and are caveated. Ath→rice and Ath→maize n are small — treat as exploratory. ProX/PU-style is a feature-family baseline, not the Plant PS proteins web model. PLAAC-approx is not the Java PLAAC HMM. Family hold-out shares negatives across train/test by design (positives strictly held out).
